# Fantasy Icon Pack by Ravenmore — February 2014 version

Artist: Ravenmore (Krzysztof Dycha).
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/fantasy-icon-pack-by-ravenmore-0
Original download: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/RavenmoreIconPack.02.2014.zip
License: CC BY 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Full license: ../CC-BY-3.0.txt
Attribution: Fantasy Icon Pack by Ravenmore — https://ravenmore.itch.io/

These PNGs are unmodified copies of selected files in the archive's 64/ folder.
No PNG resizing, recoloring or format conversion was performed. Display size
and a surrounding frame are applied in CSS. Inventory art indicates a category;
it does not reproduce the named weapons' original Langrisser designs.

Use this pinned 2014 OpenGameArt release under its CC BY license. Newer releases
on itch.io advertise a different custom license and are not included here.
